mapper.select: SELECT t.*, CASE t.type WHEN 'attendance' THEN c.name WHEN 'evaluation' THEN c.name ELSE NULL END as relatedCourseName FROM pe_teacher_todo t LEFT JOIN pe_course c ON t.id = c.id WHERE t.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND t.status != 'completed' AND t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.due_date ASC, t.create_time DESC
SELECT c.*, u.name as teacherName FROM pe_course c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalHours, SUM(CASE WHEN NOW() > end_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedHours, SUM(CASE WHEN NOW() <= end_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as upcomingHours FROM pe_course WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND deleted = 0 AND start_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 - WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)
